scope.measurement_family: Ollama server and all observed descendants only; API, retrieval, Qdrant, browser and client excluded
scope.rss_caveat: Sum includes shared pages in each process; sampled peak is not an absolute maximum
scope.pss_caveat: Only complete readable family samples; reads are sequential, not atomic
scope.latency_definition: Client request start to first nonempty model content, and to end of generation stream; not visible-answer or full-pipeline latency
scope.cache_caveat: First request has a fresh server but uncontrolled OS file cache; second request reuses a resident model and 1090/1091 prompt tokens
scope.ordering_caveat: Cells execute in fixed order, not randomized; two cache states are not two independent performance replicates

host.scope_limit: Host-visible memory and cgroup limits are separate observations; this is not a 16 GB target qualification.

budget.method: max(captured native prompt count, captured local count) + captured output cap + profile margin; no retokenization

response_identity.canonicalization: Strict JSON parse rejecting duplicate keys and nonfinite constants; Python json.dumps ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False, UTF-8; not a claim of RFC 8785 implementation

structural_difference.difference: Group B omits the second reference present in group A at the root level; comparison-level reference arrays are identical

response_identity.interpretation: Byte and structural identity observations only; JSON parsing is not schema conformance, entailment or documentary correctness

configured_probe.construction: ceil(host_visible_memory_mib) + 1; embedding estimate and release margin set to zero

exact_replay.difference: The original v1 context-checkpoint environment was ineffective; this replay explicitly sets LLAMA_ARG_CTX_CHECKPOINTS=2

native_provision.manifest_migration_condition: Fresh native digest and GGUF hash equal the prior manifest exactly

trace_serialization.not_timed: original retrieval/inference, verification reads, request construction
trace_serialization.order: off, hashes, full for each repeat; local filesystems reused; no randomized order
trace_serialization.limitation: Repeated local filesystem microbenchmark after native servers stopped; not an inference latency effect or general performance estimate.

prior_incomplete_attempts.v3_corrected_observation: One baseline response completed; the enhanced request reached admission.granted then llm.request, but no llm.response or terminal event was captured before interruption

pilot_admission.policy: No production/default-profile threshold changed; same estimate in both arms; live governor and host reserve retained. Runtime matrix measures larger f16 separately.

not_qualified: D07 full application and browser on target 16 GB hardware
